project: CB1 Activation Committor & Class A GPCR Superfamily Universality (WS4)

hypotheses.U1_universal_water_na_closure: Conserved Class A D2.50-W6.48-NPxxY internal water-wire conductance, core pore hydration, and D2.50 Na+/cation coordination collapse buried microswitch non-Markovian memory (rho_mem > 0) and improve out-of-block committor prediction across diverse Class A GPCRs.
hypotheses.U2_evolutionary_242_446_specificity: While 2.42 is aromatic (Phe/Tyr) across all 6 Class A GPCRs, 4.46 is uniquely Phe in CB1 (F155^2.42 - F237^4.46), creating a bimodal rotamer-gated aromatic lock coupled to lipid cleft wedging that is absent in CB2 (F72^2.42 - L154^4.46) and non-aromatic 4.46 Class A controls.

MOR.notes: GPCRmd open bilayer X-ray trajectories (IDs 61, 151, 169; PDBs 4DKL, 5C1M) use the crystallized oprm_mouse (P42866) 7TM construct, which shares 100% amino-acid identity with human oprm_human (P35372) across all 12 canonical Ballesteros-Weinstein positions (I1.35, Y2.42, D2.50, M3.36, R3.50, N4.46, Y5.58, L6.30, W6.48, W7.35, N7.49, Y7.53; sequence offset -2).
